# Apex Works

> Apex Works is based in Monroe, Washington. We do website audits for Washington businesses, website hosting and ongoing care, and AI optimization so tools like ChatGPT and Google's AI answers can recommend a business.

## Services

- [Apex Site Snapshot](https://theapexworks.com/snapshot): A $499 one-time website audit. Plain-English score, ranked fixes, an AI-answer check, a 20-minute Zoom walkthrough, and step-by-step instructions. The report arrives in about 48 hours after payment.
- [Site Care Plan](https://theapexworks.com/site-care): Website hosting and ongoing care. No price is listed on the page. Email damon@theapexworks.com for pricing.
- [AI optimization](https://theapexworks.com/ai-optimization): Help getting a Washington business named when people ask ChatGPT and Google's AI answers for a recommendation. No price is listed on the page. Email damon@theapexworks.com for pricing. This does not guarantee a recommendation.
